heading: Cutchi Memons to be governed in certain matters by 1[Muslim] Law
title: Cutchi Memons to be governed in certain matters by 1[Muslim] Law
text: 2. Cutchi Memons to be governed in certain matters by Muslim Law.—Subject to the provisions of section 3, all Cutchi Memons shall, in matters of succession and inheritance, be governed by the Muslim Law.
raw_text:
2. Cutchi Memons to be governed in certain matters by 1[Muslim] Law.—Subject to the 
provisions of section 3, all Cutchi Memons shall, in matters of succession and inheritance, be 
governed by the 1[Muslim] Law.

heading: Saving
title: Saving
text: 3. Saving.—Nothing in this Act shall affect any right or liability acquired or incurred before its commencement, or any legal proceeding or remedy in respect of any such right or liability; and any such legal proceeding or remedy may be continued or enforced as if this Act had not been passed.
